effect:
A Ball for the opposite gender.

Love Ball has an 8x catch rate multiplier when the wild Pokémon is the same species as yours but the opposite gender. Very situational, but incredibly effective when it applies.

Made from Pink Apricorns by Kurt. This works best when you already have one of the species you're trying to catch. Great for catching a breeding partner of the opposite gender quickly.
